about: What the lesson skill is derived from. When a source changes, the builder runs a session that brings SKILL.md back in line (builder/skill-sync.mjs); that session has no web access. Sources marked "build": true are also handed to every lesson build as current text. Private sources are read on Pavol's machine only and are never copied into this repository; the one with his own words in it (fw-signature) is not given to builds, because a build has read a web form and can reach the web.

sources.governs: What a lesson must provide and what the kit gives it; every field is documented there.
The checks every lesson must pass, as code.
The lesson page's tokens and type steps (lessons write no CSS).
What the browser walk exercises and which screenshots it leaves.
The teaching moves of this course and their status.
Where every product's signature comes from and what it refuses.
Voice, design and testing rules shared by every product.
